subject: Kepler Analytics — joint field roadshow + technical webcast plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Maya Reynolds <maya@kepleranalytics.com>, Carlos Jimenez <carlos@kepleranalytics.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kepler + Redwood: field roadshow + technical webcast idea

Hi Maya / Carlos,

Following our brief at KubeCon — congrats again on the product launch. Kepler's drift toward embedded analytics is a great fit for a joint technical roadshow + one-hour live webcast aimed at engineering leads. High-level idea below: 

- One-day half-day field roadshow in 3 cities (SF, NYC, London) with hands-on labs and a 60-min technical webcast the week after each stop.
- Focus: low-latency embeddings + model routing in production; customer case study + joint hands-on notebook.
- Redwood provides a demo instance, speaker (Eric, runtime lead), and shared paid ads for registration. Kepler owns lead gen landing page + 2 customer speakers.

Deliverables we should draft this week: joint outline, speaker bios, SOW draft with cost share, run of show. I attached a short outline (joint_outline_v1.pdf).

Are you available to sync Friday (June 12) or Monday (June 15) to lock scope and budget?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Alliances
Redwood Inference
(attachment: joint_outline_v1.pdf)

From: Maya Reynolds <maya@kepleranalytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Jimenez <carlos@kepleranalytics.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Kepler + Redwood: field roadshow + technical webcast idea

Hi Jordan — love this.

We can commit to SF and NYC for Q3; London is doable but let's pilot US first. Friday the 12th at 11am PT works for a quick 30-min sync.

Quick notes from our side:
- Kepler can provide two customer speakers for SF and one for NYC.
- We have a small events budget to contribute to venue/AV; can cover travel for one customer per city.
- For the webcast, suggest a 40/15/5 split (40 tech demo, 15 customer story + 5 Q&A).

I'll attach speaker bios after I pull them (will send later today). Also, Carlos flagged the need for a short SOW that calls out lead sharing, data handling, and co-marketing attribution.

— Maya
Head of Partnerships, Kepler Analytics
(attachment: speaker_bios.docx)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Maya Reynolds <maya@kepleranalytics.com>, Carlos Jimenez <carlos@kepleranalytics.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kepler + Redwood: field roadshow + technical webcast idea

Thanks — confirmed for Friday 11am PT. Agenda for the 30-min sync:
1) Confirm cities + target dates (we propose SF Aug 17, NYC Sep 14)
2) Split of costs (venue, AV, paid ads) and travel stipends
3) Lead sharing / attribution (HubSpot mapping + MQL criteria)
4) Run of show and technical checklist (demo infra, telemetry, slide deck owner)

Prep: Grace — can you bring a short draft SOW and a proposed run-of-show template? Marcus — we'll need your input on target accounts to invite (5 per AE).

See you Friday — calendar invite sent.

Jordan
Head of Alliances
Redwood Inference

From: Carlos Jimenez <carlos@kepleranalytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Reynolds <maya@kepleranalytics.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:25:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Kepler + Redwood: SOW draft and a couple redlines

Jordan / Grace,

Thanks for the draft SOW — we've reviewed and added a couple of redlines around lead ownership and PII handling (we want the language tighter on telemetry retention). I've attached the annotated SOW (SOW-draft-kepler-06-2026.pdf).

Two small asks:
- Can Redwood support a shared landing page that redirects to Kepler for registration (so Kepler can track full-funnel conversion)?
- On run of show, we'd like a 10-min deep dive on our embedding pipeline (Carlos) followed by the Redwood runtime demo (Eric).

If you can accept the redlines, we can sign and get internal approvals this week.

— Carlos
Director of Strategic Partnerships
Kepler Analytics
(attachment: SOW-draft-kepler-06-2026.pdf)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Maya Reynolds <maya@kepleranalytics.com>, Carlos Jimenez <carlos@kepleranalytics.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kepler + Redwood: SOW draft and a couple redlines

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Carlos. Grace and I reviewed the redlines and made two small edits: tightened telemetry retention to 90 days and clarified that shared landing page will forward registrant info to Kepler via form webhook (HubSpot mapping HS-123456789).

We accept your run-of-show order: 10-min Kepler deep dive, 30-min Redwood runtime demo, 15-min joint Q&A, 5-min closing. Marcus will reach out with the first pass at the invite list (5 target accounts per AE).

Next steps / owners: 
- Grace: finalize SOW and upload signed copy to shared Drive (deadline Tue 6/22).
- Maya: confirm speaker availability and customer travel approvals by Wed 6/23.
- Marcus: provide invite list CSV by Fri 6/25.

I'll draft the brief marketing timeline and we can align on paid budget next week. Thanks — excited to run this.

Jordan Blake
Head of Alliances
Redwood Inference
